title: 2020 AMC 10B Problem 10
statement: A three-quarter sector of a circle of radius \(4\) inches together with its interior can be rolled up to form the lateral surface of a right circular cone by taping together along the two radii shown. What is the volume of the cone in cubic inches?

solutions.text:
The sector’s arc becomes the base circumference, so if the base radius is \(r,\) then \[2\pi r=\frac34(2\pi\cdot4)=6\pi,\] giving \(r=3.\) The sector radius becomes the cone’s slant height, so the cone’s height is \[h=\sqrt{4^2-3^2}=\sqrt7.\]

Hence the volume is \[\frac13\pi r^2h=\frac13\pi(3)^2\sqrt7=3\pi\sqrt7.\] Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: The sector arc becomes the circumference of the cone base
The sector radius becomes the slant height of the cone
